name: Maxey0-SuperSpace
description: Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

skills.name: Governed context windows
skills.description: Open, describe and close explicit context windows, and gate what crosses between them.

skills.name: Containment evidence
skills.description: The hash-chained record of what was attempted across every boundary, with a verifier a third party can run.

skills.name: Gated model egress
skills.description: Model calls admitted by the gate and recorded before they leave, with the prompt digested rather than stored.
